name: LifeCycle
summary: This is a diagnostic utility EA that demonstrates the MQL5 program lifecycle by printing initialization and deinitialization events. It uses a static C++-style Loader class to trap global constructor/destructor calls and logs the deinitialization reason codes. It does not execute any trading operations.
summary_zh: 这是一个诊断工具型EA，用于演示MQL5程序的生命周期，通过打印初始化和反初始化事件来展示程序运行状态。它使用静态Loader类来捕获全局构造/析构调用，并记录反初始化原因代码，不执行任何交易操作。
strategy_analysis: 此EA并非交易策略，而是一个生命周期调试工具。它通过静态Loader类在全局初始化和终结时打印函数签名，展示MQL5中全局对象的构造和析构时机。OnInit函数打印输入参数Fake的值以及反初始化原因代码，OnDeinit函数打印具体的反初始化原因枚举字符串。仓位管理和资金管理在此EA中完全不存在，因为它不进行任何交易。其核心价值在于帮助开发者理解MQL5 EA的加载、运行和卸载流程中各回调的执行顺序。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but a lifecycle debugging utility. It uses a static Loader class with constructor and destructor to print function signatures during global initialization and finalization, demonstrating when global objects are constructed and destroyed in MQL5. The OnInit function prints the Fake input parameter value along with the uninitialization reason code, while OnDeinit logs the specific deinitialization reason as an enum string. Position sizing and money management are entirely absent since no trading occurs. Its core value lies in helping developers understand the execution order of callbacks during an MQL5 EA's load, run, and unload process. The inclusion of the Fake input parameter allows testing how input changes trigger reinitialization with different reason codes.

parameters.name: Fake
parameters.description: 虚拟输入参数，用于触发EA重新初始化以观察不同的反初始化原因代码
parameters.description_en: Virtual input to trigger EA reinitialization for deinit reason codes

pros: 清晰展示MQL5程序生命周期中各回调的执行顺序
使用静态类的构造/析构函数捕获全局初始化和终结事件，方法巧妙
通过枚举字符串输出反初始化原因，便于开发者调试理解
代码简洁明了，适合作为教学示例
pros_en: Clearly demonstrates the execution order of callbacks in the MQL5 program lifecycle
Clever use of static class constructor/destructor to trap global initialization and finalization events
Outputs deinitialization reasons as human-readable enum strings for easy debugging
Concise and clear code, suitable as a teaching example
cons: 没有任何交易功能，实用性有限
缺乏详细的注释说明各反初始化原因代码的含义
Fake参数命名不直观，未说明其用途是触发重初始化
未处理任何错误情况或异常场景
cons_en: No trading functionality at all, limited practical utility beyond education
Lacks detailed comments explaining the meaning of each deinitialization reason code
The Fake parameter name is unintuitive and does not clarify its purpose of triggering reinitialization
No error handling or edge case consideration
improvements: 添加详细注释说明每种ENUM_DEINIT_REASON的含义和使用场景
将Fake参数重命名为更具描述性的名称如ReinitTrigger，并添加说明
improvements_en: Add detailed comments explaining each ENUM_DEINIT_REASON value and its usage scenario
Rename the Fake parameter to something more descriptive like ReinitTrigger with a tooltip explanation
